title: China reject 'Cold War mindset' at UN General Assembly
summary: Beijing called on the US to "immediately" lift its blockade against Cuba, advocated for post-conflict reconstruction of Gaza, and said the sovereignty of Middle Eastern nations "should be respected."…
byline: Wesley Dockery, Mark Hallam, Felix Tamsut, Jon Shelton

blocks.text: China takes indirect swipes at US over Iran

Speaking at the UN on Saturday, Chinese Vice President Han Zheng said the world should reject "unilateral military actions that violate the UN charter and circumvent the Security Council authorization," in an apparent reference to the US attack on Iran.

"China holds that the sovereignty and security of the countries in the Middle east, including the Gulf, should be respected, international industrial and supply chains should be kept stable and unimpeded, and global trade should be safeguarded," he said.
In his speech, Han also spoke out against the US blockade of Cuba, albeit without explicitly mentioning the US.
He said China called on "the relevant country" to lift its blockade against Cuba and stop using the threat of force against the island nation.
The Chinese official also said Palestinians should govern Palestine, and urged bringing the two-state solution back "on the right track" and "at an early date."
